cookieMissing: No Bilibili Cookie was found in Surf, so crawling will run as a guest and video quality will be limited. Log in to bilibili in Surf first for higher quality.
notLoggedIn: You are not signed in, so 4K / HDR / Dolby and other higher tiers are unavailable.
bangumiLinkInVideoMode: This is a bangumi / episode link. Switch “Mode” to “Bangumi” and try again
videoIdRequired: Enter a BV id (BV13x41117TL), an av id (av1074402), or a video URL
apiNotLoggedIn: The Bilibili API reports no login (-101): no valid session was found. Log in to bilibili in Surf and try again.
riskControl: The Bilibili API triggered risk control (-352). Try again later or switch networks; if it keeps failing, sign in to bilibili again in Surf.
probeSizeFailed: Failed to probe the file size (HTTP {status})
chunkDownloadRetry: {label} failed to download ({error}); trying a backup URL
noVideoStream: playurl returned no usable video stream
noAudioStream: playurl returned no usable audio stream
muxNotBrowserSafe: {name}: the muxed result uses a codec browsers cannot play directly ({mime}); the gallery may only show a thumbnail.
ugcNoDash: playurl returned no DASH streams (this may be content such as bangumi or courses that needs a dedicated API)
videoUnavailable: This video is no longer available (title: “{title}”), skipping
partOutOfRange: This video has only {total} part(s), so part {part} does not exist
spaceBlocked: The uploader video list API is blocked by risk control ({code}). Try again later, or sign in to bilibili in Surf to reduce the chance of triggering it.
midRequired: Enter the uploader UID (digits only) or profile URL (space.bilibili.com/<UID>)
hiddenCollectionSkipped: Skipping hidden collection “{title}”: it needs the collection API, which this plugin does not support yet.
spaceSummary: [bilibili-video] Uploader {mid} has {total} videos across {pages} page(s); fetching pages {start}~{end}, {count} matched (limit {max})
spaceDeadSkipped: {count} unavailable video(s) in the uploader list were skipped.

archivesMidRequired: Collections and series need the uploader UID; paste the full space.bilibili.com URL
listDeadSkipped: {count} unavailable video(s) in the list were skipped.

favEmpty: Favorites list “{name}” is empty (the API returned 0 items).
favNonVideoSkipped: {count} non-video item(s) in the favorites list (audio, articles, etc.) were skipped.
favSummary: [bilibili-video] Favorites list “{name}” has {total} items; starting from item {offset}, {count} matched (limit {max})

listEmpty: No videos were found. Check the URL and page range

searchDeadSkipped: {count} unavailable video(s) in the search results were skipped.

geoBlocked: {name} is region-locked and cannot be watched from your current network location

bangumiNoDash: Bangumi playurl returned no DASH streams
bangumiUrlUnrecognized: Could not recognize the bangumi URL. Supported: single episode (/bangumi/play/ep21495), whole season (/bangumi/play/ss26801), media page (/bangumi/media/md24097891), or a bare ep/ss/md id
epStartOutOfRange: “{title}” has {total} main episode(s); start episode {start} is out of range
